stem_book: The horizontal range of a projectile is R and the maximum height attained by it is H. A strong wind now begins to blow in the direction of the motion of the projectile, giving it a constant horizontal acceleration = g/2. Under the same conditions of projection, the horizontal range of the projectile will now be: (a) R + H/2 (b) R + H (c) R + 3H/2 (d) R + 2H
